Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the bright polished 2.5D casual farm mobile-game scene. Create new original objects, do not reproduce its characters, train, UI or composition.

Consistent soft light from upper left. Rendered-painting quality like the reference game assets, not realistic photos or shiny AI fantasy art.
Layout is TECHNICAL: square canvas, exactly 4 columns × 4 rows of equally sized invisible cells. One distinct complete isolated object centered inside EACH cell. Each sprite must fit within the central 70% of its cell, leaving at least 15% empty transparent padding on all four sides. Never touch or cross cell boundaries. No panels, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no UI, no watermark.
Background: genuine transparent alpha channel everywhere outside the 16 objects; no white backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image, no floor, no scene, no shadow extending outside a cell.
Avoid: flat vector illustration, black outlines, pixel art, thick comic contour, photorealistic material, cinematic light, lens flare, glow halo, dark purple fantasy mood, hyper-detailed ornate filigree, generic emoji.
Exactly 16 DIFFERENT action-game sprites, reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
ROW 1: (1) full-body cheerful young runner in red cap blue outfit, side-facing right in a running pose; (2) orange-and-white road barricade with two feet; (3) chunky golden lightning-bolt energy pickup; (4) cute compact red racing car, top-down angled slightly so front faces up.
ROW 2: (5) friendly white-blue toy spaceship, nose upwards; (6) red-orange enemy toy spaceship, nose downwards, distinct from player ship; (7) small rounded golden projectile capsule; (8) cheerful blue four-rotor delivery drone.
ROW 3: (9) cute orange fish swimming right; (10) larger blue predatory fish swimming right with a few cartoon teeth, not frightening; (11) fishing hook on short line with red-white float; (12) friendly green round microbe with face.
ROW 4: (13) grumpy reddish round enemy microbe; (14) green-red push lawnmower seen three-quarter top; (15) red mushroom with cream spots; (16) friendly wheeled toy cannon pointing upper-right.
All characters have complete bodies and naturally joined limbs. All 16 objects readable at 64 px.
